component.name: EcpTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
sub run() m.base = m.top.request.base if m.base = invalid or m.base = "" m.top.response = { id: m.top.request.id, kind: m.top.request.kind, ok: false, code: -2 } return end if m.top.response = handle(m.top.request) end sub
function handle(req as object) as object res = { id: req.id, kind: req.kind, ok: false, code: 0 } if req.kind = "apps" r = http("GET", "/query/apps") res.code = r.code if r.code = 200 then res.apps = parseApps(r.body) : res.ok = true else if req.kind = "device" r = http("GET", "/query/device-info") res.code = r.code if r.code = 200 then res.device = parseFlat(r.body) : res.ok = true else if req.kind = "memories" r = http("GET", "/memories") res.code = r.code if r.code = 200 res.photos = [] data = ParseJson(r.body) ut = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") if data <> invalid and data.photos <> invalid for each n in data.photos res.photos.Push(m.base + "/memories/" + ut.Escape(n)) end for end if res.ok = true end if else if req.kind = "launch" r = http("POST", "/launch/" + req.appId) res.code = r.code res.ok = (r.code >= 200 and r.code < 300) else if req.kind = "zeus" r = http("POST", "/zeus", req.body) res.code = r.code if r.code = 200 res.zeus = ParseJson(r.body) res.ok = (res.zeus <> invalid) end if else if req.kind = "sleep" r = http("POST", "/sleep/" + req.minutes.ToStr()) res.code = r.code res.ok = (r.code >= 200 and r.code < 300) else if req.kind = "keypress" r = http("POST", "/keypress/" + req.key) res.code = r.code res.ok = (r.code >= 200 and r.code < 300) end if return res end function
function http(method as string, path as string, body = "" as string) as object ut = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") p = CreateObject("roMessagePort") ut.SetMessagePort(p) ut.SetUrl(m.base + path) ut.RetainBodyOnError(true) if method = "POST" if body <> "" then ut.AddHeader("Content-Type", "application/json") started = ut.AsyncPostFromString(body) else started = ut.AsyncGetToString() end if if not started then return { code: -1, body: "" } ev = wait(15000, p) if type(ev) <> "roUrlEvent" ut.AsyncCancel() return { code: -1, body: "" } end if return { code: ev.GetResponseCode(), body: ev.GetString() } end function
' <apps><app id="12" type="appl" version="...">Netflix</app>...</apps> function parseApps(body as string) as object out = [] xml = CreateObject("roXMLElement") if not xml.Parse(body) then return out for each a in xml.GetNamedElements("app") attrs = a.GetAttributes() if attrs.id <> "dev" out.Push({ id: attrs.id, type: attrs.type, name: a.GetText() }) end if end for return out end function
' <device-info><is-tv>true</is-tv>...</device-info> -> { "is-tv": "true", ... } function parseFlat(body as string) as object out = {} xml = CreateObject("roXMLElement") if not xml.Parse(body) then return out for each child in xml.GetChildElements() out[child.GetName()] = child.GetText() end for return out end function
